readme:
# KinPoolParty for V Rising
KinPoolParty allows players to sit inside the pools from the Oakveil DLC.

---
## Pool Party Rules
1. You must be the castle owner or clanmate to start a pool party.
2. Start a dismantle or fully dismantle the pool to end the party.
3. Seats move with their pool.
4. Seats match the pool color at party creation.
5. Repairing pool repairs the seats.
6. One party per pool.
7. No lifeguards on duty.

---

Thanks to the V Rising modding and server communities for ideas and requests!
Feel free to reach out to me on discord (odjit) if you have any questions or need help with the mod.

[V Rising Modding Discord](https://vrisingmods.com/discord)

## Commands

- `.poolparty`
  - Starts a pool party at the pool you are hovering over.
  - Shortcut: `.pool`
